headline: Ocean-freight stress is HIGH and holding — 42.6/100; Luzon Strait is the lead driver, -20% vs normal

bullets.text: Global Ocean Freight Stress is **42.6/100** (**high**), flat week-over-week. 4 of 28 monitored chokepoints are disrupted.
The biggest driver is **Luzon Strait**, running **82.0/day** vs a normal of **103.0/day** (-20%).
**330** changes to the disruption set since the last update.
Also moving now: **Bosporus Strait** is running **50% below** normal.
Market context: Brent crude **$113.96/bbl** (-5.01% prev_close) — context for the energy-route chokepoints, not a stated cause.
Against the loaded sample trade book, **$396.5M** routes through disrupted lanes — an estimated **$3.2M** cost-of-delay ($1.7M–$5.1M).
